conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 5. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 8.9 | 4.5 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 9.0 | 4.5 | 450 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 9.0 | 4.5 | 450 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 8.8 | 4.4 | 450 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
